notes: Extra EVA scenarios, one per habitat, on the 6 km map. Habitats and stops are in projected metres (Mars 2000 equidistant cylindrical), so they do not move when the map crop changes; the app works out local x/y from area.json boundsProjected. Every stop is a real Curiosity waypoint. Stop order and minutes are draft team estimates; names, science and photos need Kelly's review. EVA-07 and EVA-08 keep their own files (science-stops.json, gediz-stops.json) and are listed here only for the picker.

H1.name: Habitat H1
H1.note: Confirmed team habitat: start of EVA-07 and EVA-09, and the drive start for EVA-08. About 3° slope.

H2.name: Habitat H2
H2.note: Flat-site candidate from the 6 km terrain script (area.json habitatCandidates[0]); mean slope 3.7° over about 100 m. North-west of the boxwork.

H3.name: Habitat H3
H3.note: Flat-site candidate from the 6 km terrain script (area.json habitatCandidates[1]); mean slope 4.1° over about 100 m. East of the boxwork.

H4.name: Habitat H4
H4.note: Flat-site candidate from the 6 km terrain script (area.json habitatCandidates[2]); mean slope 4.4° over about 100 m. North-east of the boxwork, east of the Gediz Vallis stops.
